text:
maria: hey @docs-team — opening a PR with migration notes for rate tiers + a small SDK header snippet. cc: @kevin @alex. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

kevin: looking now. does this change the `X-Usage-Tier` header to `X-Redwood-Tier`? we need to call out backward compat.

maria: yes: old header `X-Usage-Tier` -> new `X-Redwood-Tier`. Added a short Python example showing how to set it:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key)
# set per-request header
resp = client.generate("Write a short summary", headers={"X-Redwood-Tier": "pro"})
```

alex: tiny nit: change example to use `client.headers.update(...)` to align with SDK v2 style. also add short note about dashboard labels (`tier_label` metric).

maria: done — pushed commit. Also added a dashboard link to the usage panel (dashboards/usage-tiers). Can someone add a small screenshot placeholder? I don't have permissions to attach images in PR. (screenshot: /images/usage-tiers.png)

samira: I'll grab one during the next deployment. quick question: does burst credits still apply per tier? doc should say yes + show formula.

kevin: yes — call out `burst_credits` metric and example calculation: `effective_rate = base_rate + min(burst_credits/period, burst_cap)`

docs-bot: reminder — docs PR #482 assigned to @alex for final review. Review deadline: 48h.

alex: on it. will review today and leave inline comments. :eyes:
